description_en: This operation queries the billing information of a backup plan
description_zh: 该接口用于查看备份计划计费信息
name: DescribeBackupPlanBilling

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup plan. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 备份计划ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value. It must be unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to display the storage class
parameters.name: show_storage_type

ErrMessage.example: This backupPlan can't support this action

Item.description_en: The billing information of the backup plan
Item.description_zh: 备份计划计费信息列表

BuyChargeType.description_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

PREPAY: subscription

POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go
BuyChargeType.description_zh:
购买费用类型，返回值如下：

PREPAY：预付费（包年包月）
POSTPAY：后付费（按量付费）

BuyCreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp that indicates when the instance was purchased
BuyCreateTimestamp.description_zh: 实例购买时间，格式为时间戳

BuyExpiredTimestamp.description_en:
The timestamp that indicates when the instance expires.

This parameter is returned only when BuyChargeType is set to PREPAY
BuyExpiredTimestamp.description_zh:
实例到期时间，格式为时间戳。
该参数仅在BuyChargeType选择PREPAY时显示

ContStorageSize.description_en: The storage space used by incremental backup data. Unit: bytes
ContStorageSize.description_zh: 实例增量备份数据内置存储量，单位为字节（B）

FullStorageSize.description_en: The storage space used by full backup data. Unit: bytes
FullStorageSize.description_zh: 实例全量备份数据内置存储量，单位为字节（B）

IsExpired.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance has expired.

This parameter is returned only when BuyChargeType is set to PREPAY
IsExpired.description_zh:
实例是否过期。
该参数仅在BuyChargeType选择PREPAY时显示

IsFreeBytesUnlimited.description_en: Indicates whether the instance provides unlimited free backup traffic
IsFreeBytesUnlimited.description_zh: 实例是否为无备份流量上限规格

PaiedBytes.description_en: The total paid backup traffic in the current month. Unit: bytes
PaiedBytes.description_zh: 当月付费备份流量合计，单位为字节（B）

QuotaEndTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp that indicates the end of the billing cycle for the free backup traffic
QuotaEndTimestamp.description_zh: 免费备份流量计费周期结束时间，格式为时间戳

QuotaStartTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp that indicates the start of the billing cycle for the free backup traffic
QuotaStartTimestamp.description_zh: 免费备份流量计费周期开始时间，格式为时间戳

TotalFreeBytes.description_en:
The total free backup traffic in the current month. Unit: bytes.

This parameter is returned only when BuyChargeType is set to PREPAY and IsFreeBytesUnlimited is false
TotalFreeBytes.description_zh:
当月免费备份总流量，单位为字节（B）。
该参数仅在BuyChargeType选择PREPAY且IsFreeBytesUnlimited为false时显示

UsedFullBytes.description_en: The paid traffic for full backups in the current month. Unit: bytes
UsedFullBytes.description_zh: 当月付费全量备份流量，单位为字节（B）

UsedIncrementBytes.description_en: The paid traffic for incremental backups in the current month. Unit: bytes
UsedIncrementBytes.description_zh: 当月付费增量备份流量，单位为字节（B）

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
